summary: Iteration 7 — Full backend + frontend validation of the BIBLIA translation manager + avatar editor + lexicon/new-lessons rollout. Backend: 2 required endpoints + 2 regression tests PASS. GET /api/bible/translations returns both elb1905 (available:true, 'Elberfelder 1905 (gemeinfrei)') and elb2006 (available:false, mentions 'lizenzpflichtig'). GET /api/bible/1/1?t=elb2006 → 404 with detail 'Übersetzung 'elb2006' nicht verfügbar'. Unknown translation 404 and ?t=elb1905 passthrough also verified. Total backend run: 13/14 pass (the one failing test — TestHealth.test_health — hits the root-level /health which the K8s ingress routes to the Expo frontend HTML, not to FastAPI; it is a pre-existing routing quirk unrelated to this review). Fixed one stale assertion in test_bible_api.py (translation field now returns id 'elb1905', not display name). Frontend (viewport 390x844, each flow walks past the ~10s intro via intro-skip-button): (1) Intro shows 'BIBLIA' + 'by Absole' before skip — confirmed by DOM text scan. (2) Settings: translation-elb2006 shows exact string 'Elberfelder Bibel, Edition 2006 · nicht lizenziert – Anzeige: Elberfelder 1905'; selecting it + opening Bible tab yields bible-translation-label='Angezeigt: Elberfelder 1905 · ELB 2006 nicht lizenziert' and chapter body renders (5.9kB text, verses visible). (3) Avatar editor: avatar-editor loads from /avatar and from profile-avatar-card tap; all four tabs (avatar-tab-basis/face/hair/extras) switch; combos hair-long + hat-straw and random all apply; avatar-save persists; profile-avatar-name reflects it; avatar-cancel-button discards unsaved changes (name stays 'IntegTest' after typing 'CancelMe' and cancelling); after page reload the avatar persists (AsyncStorage/web storage). (4) Avatar integration end-to-end in one session: hud-avatar on home, campaign-avatar on /world/gospels adventure mode, map-me-marker ('Du' pill, dashed border, 40×40, bbox (140.8,562.2)) on history mode, avatar-station-start on station x-jona phase 0, station-connections at phase 2. Important finding: AvatarCheer / map-me-marker correctly guard with 'if (!state.avatar) return null;' — so these elements render ONLY after an avatar has been saved. (5) New lessons: /station/x-jona renders station-goal + station-info-chips (info-chip-jona/-ninive/-prophet/-jesus) in phase 0; opening info-chip-jona opens info-sheet with info-show-map (navigates to /?theme=prophets&place=nineveh with Ninive place sheet) and info-show-timeline. All five requested stations render (x-elia, x-jona, x-emmaus, x-athen, x-bartimaeus, x-jakob) with station-goal present. On /world/prophets both station-node-x-elia (aria-label '12. Elia am Karmel, gesperrt' → locked as spec'd) and station-node-x-jona are present. (6) Library Lexikon shows lexicon-infotafeln and open-timeline. (7) PlaceSheet from home map place-node-jerusalem shows place-info-chips. (8) Existing parables-1 shows station-info-chips. Only warning in console: pre-existing 'shadow*' style deprecation (JourneyLayer) — non-blocking cosmetic carried over from iteration 6. Also a dev-only 'GO_BACK' warning from router.back() in avatar editor when deep-linked (not reproducible via normal navigation).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning still logged: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking cosmetic — carried over from iter 5/6. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/JourneyLayer.tsx (shadow* props on medal).

action_items: COSMETIC (optional, carried over): migrate shadow* -> boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/components/JourneyLayer.tsx to remove the RN Web deprecation warning.

COSMETIC (optional): router.back() in /app/frontend/app/avatar.tsx logs 'GO_BACK was not handled' when the avatar screen is deep-linked (no history). Consider router.navigate('/profile') as fallback when !router.canGoBack().
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/bible/translations correctly flags elb2006 as unavailable until backend/data/elb2006.json is present (server.py:60-68). /api/bible/{book}/{chapter}?t=elb2006 raises 404 with meaningful detail (server.py:72-78).

Frontend never mis-labels 1905 text as 2006: bible.tsx:115 renders the actual chosen translation name and appends '· <short> nicht lizenziert' when the chosen id is unavailable (verified live). settings.tsx:75 shows 'nicht lizenziert – Anzeige: Elberfelder 1905' on the elb2006 option — matches the user's requirement.

AvatarCheer in StationExtras.tsx:68-78 and GeoMap map-me-marker (GeoMap.tsx:147-154) both correctly guard on state.avatar/me — so the integrated avatar presence tests pass as soon as an avatar is saved. No defect here; prior false-negatives were due to a fresh browser context in a separate test session (AsyncStorage not shared).
StationExtras.AvatarCheer passes testID through to the Animated.View — avatar-station-start/complete testIDs confirmed present at the expected phases.
InfoSheet navigation targets look correct: info-show-map → /?theme=prophets&place=nineveh (confirmed to open the Ninive PlaceSheet), info-show-timeline → timeline-screen.

success_rate.backend: 13/14 (2/2 required endpoints 100%; the single failing test TestHealth.test_health hits root /health which the ingress routes to Expo frontend — pre-existing, unrelated)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all requested scope (intro, translation UI, avatar editor + persistence + cancel, HUD/campaign/history-map/station-start integration, new lessons incl. x-jona/x-elia/x-emmaus/x-athen/x-bartimaeus/x-jakob, lexicon, place info chips, prophets lock state)

seed_data_creation: None persisted on backend. Local avatar 'IntegTest' saved in web storage during integrated session (not shared across subsequent test runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both /api/bible/translations and /api/bible/1/1?t=elb2006 are stable. Frontend avatar/map/station integrations only render once state.avatar is non-null — ALWAYS save an avatar first in the same Playwright session before asserting hud-avatar, campaign-avatar, map-me-marker, avatar-station-start/-complete, otherwise you will get false negatives (AvatarCheer and GeoMap me-marker guard on state.avatar). Each new browser context starts with no avatar. Intro overlay (~10s with 'BIBLIA' + 'by Absole') appears on every initial load — use intro-skip-button. map-mode-history/map-mode-adventure testIDs are only on /world/[id], not on home. place-node-* on home map opens PlaceSheet with place-info-chips.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no new blockers. During investigation the only transient red herring was map-me-marker/avatar-station-start reading as absent across isolated Playwright sessions; root cause was that each session starts with empty web storage so state.avatar was undefined and the components correctly short-circuit. Verified correct behavior by chaining avatar-save → station → world history in a single session.
